title: Gemini 4 Argon comes to the Gemini app.
gist: Gemini 4 Argon arrives in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, alongside Antigravity in the macOS app and a chat-to-tasks toggle. Gemini now connects to more than 40 apps including Instacart, OpenTable, Adobe and Shopify.

insights.claim: Google is shifting the Gemini app from chat toward delegated work by adding a chat-to-tasks toggle in which Gemini works for the user even when away from the computer, across Google apps and others.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Background task execution moves consumer AI toward agents and makes subscriptions stickier.
insights.quote: When you choose tasks, Gemini can work for you even when you’re not at your computer

insights.claim: Gemini now connects to more than 40 third-party apps, including Instacart, OpenTable, Adobe and Shopify, covering ordering groceries, booking tables and building a business.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: App integrations make Gemini a transaction layer, with exposure for commerce and booking partners.
insights.locator: Gemini now connects you to more than 40 apps

insights.claim: Google AI Antigravity's agentic coding interface is now built into the Gemini macOS app, and Argon is pitched as a major coding improvement, making it easy to switch between chatting and coding.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Bundling a coding agent into the consumer app widens Google's surface against dedicated coding tools.
insights.locator: Argon also brings major improvements in coding

insights.claim: Access to Argon and tasks in the Gemini app is restricted to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, so the new model is a paid-tier upsell.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Frontier capability is used to drive paid subscription conversion.
insights.locator: Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can now access
